dedupe_keys.name: pcse python crop simulation environment with wofost lintul3 and lingra

description: PCSE is a Python package for building crop simulation models, in particular those developed in Wageningen. It provides the environment to run the models, readers for weather, soil and agromanagement data, and components for processes such as phenology, respiration and evapotranspiration. It includes the WOFOST, LINTUL3 and LINGRA crop and grassland models; WOFOST is used operationally in the MARS crop yield forecasting system for crop monitoring and yield prediction in Europe and beyond. Coverage is generic. Access is free: the package is on PyPI (version 6.0.13 read) with documentation on Read the Docs and code on GitHub, under the European Union Public Licence 1.2. PCSE runs on Python 3.6 and later. Caveats: crop, soil and site parameters must be supplied or calibrated, and the documentation was generated on 6 November 2025. For simulation it gives yield and water-limited production under weather scenarios for drought and heat impact and forecasting studies. Related catalogue records include the JRC MARS agri4cast data, DSSAT, APSIM and the GGCMI outputs, where CGMS-WOFOST is a participant.
